jd.title: Business Analyst (Entry Level)
jd.raw_text:
Business Analyst (Entry Level) — FinEdge Solutions, Mumbai

We are hiring an entry-level Business Analyst to work with product and engineering teams in our fintech division.

Responsibilities:
- Gather and document business requirements (BRD, FRD)
- Communicate with stakeholders to clarify needs
- Analyze data in Excel and write SQL queries
- Create wireframes using Figma or Balsamiq
- Work in an Agile / Scrum environment

Required skills: requirement gathering, stakeholder communication, Excel, SQL, BRD, FRD, documentation, Agile, Scrum, wireframing.
Nice to have: Power BI, fintech domain knowledge, JIRA, UML.

Eligibility: BBA / BCA / B.Com freshers with strong communication and analytical skills.
